rules.title: Ban on algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy
rules.requirement: Landlords in San Francisco may not use, and vendors may not sell, software that analyzes nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rents or manage occupancy. If you believe a landlord or vendor is violating this, you (or the City Attorney) can bring a civil lawsuit.

coverage.summary: All residential units in San Francisco; the prohibition applies to any entity selling or using algorithmic rent-setting devices.

rules.penalty: Tenant or City Attorney may bring a civil action against a violating entity.
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.

notes: Official Rent Board news summary of Rent Ordinance Section 37.10C (S.F. Admin. Code Chapter 37). Specific civil penalty amounts are not stated in this document.
